<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:fct="http://openlinksw.com/services/facets/1.0/" xmlns:mctx="gttp://ggg.maestro.ecosys/ns/xslt/context#" xmlns="http://openlinksw.com/services/facets/1.0" version="3.0" exclude-result-prefixes="xs fct mctx">
<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8" omit-xml-declaration="yes"/>
<xsl:param name="recordUri" as="xs:string"/>
<xsl:template match="/">
<xsl:variable name="reviewPredicate" select="string((mctx:context/mctx:describe/fct:facets/fct:result[@type='describe']/fct:row[fct:column[1] = $recordUri and fct:column[2] = ('http://schema.org/review','https://schema.org/review','http://schema.org/reviews','https://schema.org/reviews')]/fct:column[2])[1])"/>
<xsl:variable name="address" select="string(mctx:context/mctx:query/*[local-name()='query']/@addr)"/>
<query addr="{$address}">
<value datatype="uri"><xsl:value-of select="$recordUri"/></value>
<xsl:if test="$reviewPredicate ne ''">
<property iri="{$reviewPredicate}">
<property iri="http://schema.org/author" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/name" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/reviewBody" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/ratingValue" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/reviewRating" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/reviewRating">
<property iri="http://schema.org/ratingValue" project="yes"/>
<property iri="http://schema.org/bestRating" project="yes"/>
</property>
<view type="list-values" limit="5" offset="0"/>
</property>
</xsl:if>
</query>
</xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
